components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast primary action button for Start listening, Send, and Save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid transparent; background:#38bdf8; color:#090c11; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:rgba(56,189,248,0.85); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Stop Listening Button
components.description: High-contrast destructive action button for Stop listening and delete confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:28px; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid rgba(251,113,133,0.25); background:rgba(244,63,94,0.2); color:#ffe4e6; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background:rgba(244,63,94,0.3); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(251,113,133,0.5); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Answer Card
components.description: Elevated graphite card for streamed AI answers with 68ch readable measure.
components.html:
Use a transactional outbox table.

Commit the domain row and event inside the same Postgres transaction.
components.css: .ds-answer-card { max-width:68ch; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.2); background:#1e2532; padding:20px; color:#eef2f7; font-size:14px; line-height:1.6; } .ds-answer-card strong { display:block; font-size:15.5px; font-weight:600; color:#fff; margin-bottom:6px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: Left obsidian rail navigation button with active page state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; width:100%; height:36px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:8px; border:none; background:transparent; color:#94a3b8; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; transition:background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color:#eef2f7; } .ds-nav-active { background:#1e293b; color:#38bdf8; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Studio Text Input
components.description: Recessed obsidian input field used in settings, provider forms, and search.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:36px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); background:#0f131a; color:#eef2f7; font-size:13px; outline:none; transition:border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#38bdf8; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(56,189,248,0.2); }

narrative.overview:
Atelier Obsidian transforms Meetingly from a cramped floating popup into a calm, spacious desktop studio built for engineers, founders, and candidates on live video calls. A deep matte obsidian navigation rail grounds the workspace, separating navigation and local-keychain status from the graphite live-reading canvas so answers and incoming speech stay scannable at a glance without visual glare.

Every surface earns its space: generous padding (20px–24px), a restrained single primary sky accent, crisp 1px hairlines instead of heavy drop shadows, and a dual-column live workspace that keeps real-time AI answers beside the live speaker transcript.
keyCharacteristics: Deep tonal layering across matte obsidian rail (#0f131a), graphite canvas (#161b24), and elevated answer cards (#1e2532).
Spacious dual-window architecture: a breathable 48px always-on-top toolbar paired with a 920×640 studio workspace.
Single primary accent (#38bdf8) reserved strictly for primary actions, active navigation, and live focus rings.
High-legibility 14px body prose constrained to 68ch measure with bold 15.5px lead-in answer lines.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Studio Sky (#38bdf8) marks primary actions, active navigation, and focus indicators only; live capture states use Rose (#f43f5e), ready/saved states use Emerald (#34d399), and setup warnings use Amber (#fbbf24).

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every live clock, meeting duration, segment counter, and character counter uses tabular-nums so horizontal alignment never shifts while counting.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Declare interior card elevation with either a 1px border or a shadow, never both simultaneously (no ghost cards).

dos: Do keep 68ch max prose measure and 20px internal padding on streamed answer cards so answers remain readable while speaking.
Do validate provider URLs, required API keys, prompt text, and duplicate shortcuts upfront with inline field errors before IPC submission.
Do preserve data-no-drag on interactive header controls and getCurrentWindow().startDragging() on frameless window drag regions.
Do require AlertDialog confirmation before discarding non-empty live transcripts, clearing chat, or deleting providers/prompts/meetings.
donts: Don't crowd toggles or secondary pills into the 56px live session header ribbon—keep it focused on view title, live state, session controls, and close.
Don't combine a 1px border with a drop shadow on interior cards.
Don't add decorative looping animations that ignore prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Don't omit keyboard focus-visible rings on custom buttons or aria-label on icon-only controls.
